notes: σιωπήσῃς heads on 'peace' as the meaning-bearing complement of the support-verb idiom 'hold thy peace' under rule 17; heading on 'hold' remains defensible if the whole idiom is read as the verb's gloss.
Both μή particles are ordinary negatives aligned to 'not'; neither is interrogative, so rules 44 and 64 do not apply.
τῷ before Παύλῳ is unrepresented under rule 23 and the case preposition 'unto' stays with the name under rule 21, the ASV writing no determiner.
